To investigate the brain basis of allopregnanolone’s impact on emotion regulation, participants were administered 400mg of pregnenolone (N=16) or placebo (N=15) and underwent 3T fMRI while performing the Shifted-Attention Emotion Appraisal Task (SEAT), which probes emotional processing and regulation.

description.value: An emotional appraisal task using compound stimuli with emotional faces and neutral scenes, requiring gender, inside/outside, or like/dislike judgments.

spans.text: In three different conditions, participants are asked to respond to three different questions: (1) ‘Gender’: Whether the face in the foreground is male or female; (2) ‘Inside/Outside’: Whether the scene in the background is indoors or outdoors; or (3) ‘Like/Dislike’: Whether the face in the foreground is liked or disliked.
